skills.name: writer
skills.description: Base clean-prose editor — antinyeyroslop (28 categories), typography, structural synthetics, RU calques. Invoked by all other prose skills.

skills.name: viral-text
skills.description: Write viral social media content — hooks, numbered points, micro-conclusion with NLP question, CTA. 41 viral content rules + platform adaptation.

skills.name: prose-edit
skills.description: Fiction rewrite layer — Pelevin/Manson voice vector, 10-item style drift checklist, no meta-refs / anglicisms in narrator voice, long artistic rewrite (no comma-stitching), ToV pattern, 5-trigger structural-synthesis detector, Postirony depth-pass.

skills.name: essay-write
skills.description: Non-fiction layer — long subordinate sentences (Manson style), source-backed claims, philosophy through humor, biography through scenes, plain-Russian for complex content.

skills.name: style-check
skills.description: Read-only pre-commit lint that stacks writer + prose-edit + essay-write rules. Routes by configurable path patterns (fiction vs non-fic), BLOCKING/WARNING/INFO severity, exit-code semantics for git hook.

skills.name: translation-sync
skills.description: Read-only pre-commit parity checker for trilingual book translations (RU↔EN↔PT-BR) — typography per language, terminology canon, anchor-quote drift, names/patronymics/diminutives, cultural realia footnotes, no-smoothing of numbers/brands/dates. BLOCKING/WARNING/INFO severity with exit-code semantics for git hook.

skills.name: canon-check
skills.description: Story-bible consistency auditor for any book series. Greps entities (characters / artifacts / locations) in changed chapters, cross-references the project's story-bible document, flags BLOCKING contradictions / WARNING gaps / INFO new details. Read-only — trust the text, not memory.

skills.name: pelevin-digression
skills.description: Write a Pelevin-style digression for a fiction or non-fiction passage — 12 structural techniques + 5 banned constructions. Wraps prose-edit (fiction) or essay-write (non-fic). Invoked by request, not auto-applied.

skills.name: skills-update
skills.description: User-invocable update check + apply for this collection. Compares local install marker with latest GitHub release, shows CHANGELOG diff, asks for confirmation, runs install.sh --update.

skills.name: tone-shifter
skills.description: Rewrite a passage in a different register (formal↔casual, business↔academic, technical↔friendly, plain-explainer) without changing meaning. 6 registers + named transformation deltas. Wraps writer as final cleanup.

skills.name: cold-email
skills.description: Write or rewrite cold outreach emails (first-touch, follow-up, intro request, re-engage). 5-block structure, ≤120-word budget, banned ceremony patterns, anti-template subject lines. Wraps writer as final cleanup.

skills.name: image-prompt
skills.description: Write prompts for AI image generators (Midjourney, DALL-E, Flux, Nano Banana, Stable Diffusion). 6-part formula (subject + setting + style + lighting + camera + texture), per-model deltas, negative prompts.

skills.name: video-prompt
skills.description: Write prompts for AI video generators (Kling, Veo, Sora, Runway, Pika, Hailuo, Luma). CHARACTER FIRST law, beat structure (Beat 1/2/3), exact camera vocabulary, pacing modes (narrative/action/comedy/documentary/timelapse).

skills.name: microcopy
skills.description: Write UX microcopy — error messages, empty states, tooltips, button labels, helper text, modals, 404/500 pages, onboarding. Plain language, action-oriented, never blame user, length budgets per element type. Wraps writer for final cleanup.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Write user-facing release notes + changelogs. Keep-a-Changelog format, sections Added/Changed/Fixed/Deprecated/Removed/Security. Per-audience tone (user/dev/ops). Anti-marketing-fluff bans. Wraps writer.

skills.name: rfc-writer
skills.description: Write engineer-facing design docs — RFCs, ADRs, Tech Specs, Design Docs. Structure: context/problem/proposal/alternatives/consequences/decision. RFC 2119 (MUST/SHOULD/MAY). Review checklist for spotting weak alternatives sections.

skills.name: landing-copy
skills.description: Write marketing copy — landing page sections (hero/features/pricing/FAQ), SEO meta (title+description+OG+Twitter), ad copy (Google/Facebook/LinkedIn/X). Julian Shapiro hero formula, char limits per platform. Wraps writer.
